title: Pullback of locally constant finite module sheaves
statement:
Let $f:V\to X$ be any morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme] and let $A$ be a finite commutative ring. Use their small pro-etale sites [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site] and constant ring sheaves $A_X,A_V$ [def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf]. The module inverse image $f^*$ is that of [def-weil-proetale-inverse-image], with the canonical coefficient-ring isomorphism $f^{-1}A_X\cong A_V$ of [prop-weil-pbc-proetale-constant-ring-map]. Suppose $F$ is an $A_X$-module sheaf which is locally constant [def-weil-proetale-locally-constant-sheaf] with finite module models: it admits a pro-etale covering $\{U_j\to X\}$ and isomorphisms $F|_{U_j}\cong\underline{M_j}_{U_j}$, where every $M_j$ is a finite $A$-module. Then on the base-changed covering $\{V\times_XU_j\to V\}$ there are isomorphisms of module sheaves
$$
 (f^*F)|_{V\times_XU_j}\cong\underline{M_j}_{V\times_XU_j}.
$$
In particular, $f^*F$ is locally constant with the same finite module models. This assertion includes empty schemes and empty covering members.

proof.text: The base-change functor defining the pro-etale inverse image preserves finite limits and coverings, so by the site pullback construction it gives a geometric morphism of the two pro-etale topoi. The module inverse image in the statement is $f^*F=f^{-1}F\otimes_{f^{-1}A_X}A_V$ along the structure map $c$, which [prop-weil-pbc-proetale-constant-ring-map] shows is an isomorphism. Tensoring along a ring isomorphism is $f^{-1}F$ with $A_V$ acting through $c^{-1}$. This is the module inverse image $f_A^*$ of [lem-pe-constant-left-module-inverse-image]: its canonical isomorphism $f^{-1}A_X\cong A_V$ also preserves constant scalars, so it equals $c$, since a ring-sheaf map out of the constant sheaf $A_V$ is determined on constant sections. Apply [lem-sfb-geometric-inverse-image-constant-module] to this morphism with the finite $A$-module $M_j$. It gives a canonical $A_V$-linear isomorphism $f^*\underline{M_j}_X\cong\underline{M_j}_V$.

source.place: Tag 093R, lemma-pullback-locally-constant; the pro-etale geometric-morphism specialization uses Tags 00X6 and 00YV

proof.text:
Put $W_j=V\times_XU_j=u_f(U_j)$. The family $\{W_j\to V\}$ is a covering because the base-change functor $u_f$ of [def-weil-proetale-inverse-image] is covering-preserving. Apply [lem-weil-pbc-localize-ringed-site-morphism] to $u_f$, the ring map $c:f^{-1}A_X\to A_V$ and the object $U_j$. It gives the localized morphism of sites $f_j:V_{\mathrm{proet}}/W_j\to X_{\mathrm{proet}}/U_j$, induced by $(T\to U_j)\mapsto(u_f(T)\to W_j)$, with ring map $c|_{W_j}$. It also gives a natural isomorphism $(f^*F)|_{W_j}\cong f_j^*(F|_{U_j})$ of tensor module pullbacks. The ring map $c|_{W_j}$ is an isomorphism, being the restriction of the isomorphism of [prop-weil-pbc-proetale-constant-ring-map]. So, as in step 1, $f_j^*$ is the module inverse image of [lem-pe-constant-left-module-inverse-image] for the geometric morphism $f_j$. Restricted constant ring sheaves are the constant ring sheaves of the localized sites, by the same lemma applied to the localization morphisms. Apply $f_j^*$ to the given trivialization $F|_{U_j}\cong\underline{M_j}_{U_j}$, then apply [lem-sfb-geometric-inverse-image-constant-module] to $f_j$. The composite is
$$
 (f^*F)|_{W_j}\cong f_j^*(F|_{U_j})\cong f_j^*\underline{M_j}_{U_j}\cong\underline{M_j}_{W_j}.
$$
Each $M_j$ is unchanged, hence remains a finite $A$-module. These are precisely the required local trivializations. No step selects a point or a nonzero section: for an empty $W_j$ both module sheaves are zero, so the same isomorphism applies. For empty $X$ the covering may be empty, and then so is its base change.

lean.statement: theorem proEtaleConstantModulePullback_locallyConstant {V X : Scheme.{u}} (f : V ⟶ X) (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [Finite A] (F : SheafOfModules.{u + 1} ((sheafCompose (ProEt.topology X) (forget₂ CommRingCat.{u + 1} RingCat.{u + 1})).obj (proEtaleConstantRing X A))) (I : Type (u + 1)) (U : I → X.ProEt) (a : ∀ i : I, U i ⟶ ProEt.mk (𝟙 X)) (hcover : Presieve.ofArrows U a ∈ (ProEt.precoverage X).coverings _) (M : I → ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1, u} A)) (hfinite : ∀ i : I, Finite (M i)) (htrivial : ∀ i : I, Nonempty (F.over (U i) ≅ proEtaleConstantModuleSheafOver X A (U i) (M i))) : ∃ b : ∀ i : I, (proEtaleBaseChange f).obj (U i) ⟶ ProEt.mk (𝟙 V), Presieve.ofArrows (fun i : I ↦ (proEtaleBaseChange f).obj (U i)) b ∈ (ProEt.precoverage V).coverings _ ∧ (∀ i : I, Nonempty ((proEtaleConstantModulePullback f A F).over ((proEtaleBaseChange f).obj (U i)) ≅ proEtaleConstantModuleSheafOver V A ((proEtaleBaseChange f).obj (U i)) (M i))) ∧ IsLocallyConstantProEtaleModuleSheaf V A (proEtaleConstantModulePullback f A F)
